title: NetworkMachinePairing
description: network.machine-pairing@1: a one-time code that pairs a machine with the person's account (POST /api/v1/machines/pairings, capability machines.manage). The code is shown once, expires, and works once: the machine redeems it and becomes the person's. The command is what the owner runs on the machine (openvibe.bot/install). The code is never stored in the clear and never returned again.

code.description: The one-time pairing code, eight Crockford base32 characters in two groups (XXXX-XXXX).

pairing_id.description: The pairing's id, as the install command carries it. Absent when the authority behind it does not name one.

installer.description: The command the owner runs on the machine (openvibe.bot/install, with the network, the pairing id and the code).
